name: How do you match existing paint for touch-ups?

mainEntity.name: How do you match existing paint for touch-ups?

acceptedAnswer.text: Accurate paint matching is crucial for seamless touch-ups. We start by requesting any leftover paint cans or color codes you might have from the original painting project. If these are unavailable, our team can carefully take a small sample from an inconspicuous area of your wall, such as behind a picture frame or outlet cover. This sample is then professionally matched using color-matching technology or by a paint expert to ensure the new paint blends perfectly with the existing finish, minimizing noticeable differences.
acceptedAnswer.description: We match existing paint using leftover cans, color codes, or by taking a small sample from your wall for professional matching.
